title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?
abstract: arXiv:2609.01924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work identifies a mid-depth band of verbalisable, causally potent representations in a standard feedforward transformer --- a functional analogue of a global workspace. Whether the same workspace functionality emerges when depth is implemented through recurrence rather than a stack of distinct layers remains unknown. Looped and depth-recurrent transformers provide a direct test of this question because they reuse the same weights across depth. We extend the Jacobian lens to iterated architectures using a virtual-unrolling adapter. We apply the full workspace suite --- lens fitting, readout, and eleven causal experiment families --- to Ouro-2.6B (48 layers looped 4 times, deeply supervised) and Huginn-0125 (a 4-layer core recurred 16 times, trained for latent reasoning), using Qwen3.6-27B (64 untied layers) as the standard baseline. translated_title: 雅可比透镜下的循环Transformer：全局工作空间能否在循环中存续？
translated_abstract: 近期研究在标准前馈Transformer的中层深度处发现了一条可言语化、具有因果效力的表征带——一个功能上等同于“全局工作空间”的结构。然而，当深度通过循环而非一系列独立层的堆叠来实现时，同样的工作空间功能是否依然涌现，目前尚不清楚。循环Transformer与深度递归Transformer为这一问题提供了直接的检验手段，因为它们在深度方向上重复使用同一组权重。我们借助虚拟展开适配器，将雅可比透镜方法扩展至迭代式架构。我们将完整的工作空间分析套件——包括透镜拟合、读出以及十一类因果实验——应用于Ouro-2.6B（48层循环4次，采用深度监督）和Huginn-0125（4层核心递归16次，为潜在推理而训练），并以Qwen3.6-27B（64层非共享权重）作为标准基线。我们发现，在每种架构的迭代部分均会形成工作空间，但循环改变了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将雅可比透镜方法扩展到循环与深度递归Transformer，发现全局工作空间功能在这些迭代式架构的循环部分依然能够形成，但循环会改变其原有特性。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Jacobian lens to looped and depth-recurrent transformers via a virtual-unrolling adapter, showing that a global workspace still forms in the iterated part of each architecture, although recurrence alters its properties.
